# Monitor Boundary

Visibility into Boundary's components helps you keep controllers and workers healthy. Boundary provides listeners that expose monitoring endpoints, Prometheus metrics, a health endpoint, events that you can route to sinks, and a debug mode.

This section organizes each monitoring feature into overview, usage, and reference topics so you can find the type of information you need.

## Listeners

Listeners define the addresses and ports on which Boundary responds to requests. TCP and Unix listeners are available. The `ops` listener hosts the metrics and health endpoints.

- [Listeners overview](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners)
- [TCP listener](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/tcp)
- [Unix listener](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/unix)
- [Configure TLS for listeners](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/configure-tls)
- [Configure custom response headers](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/configure-custom-response-headers)
- [Configure multiple listeners](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/configure-multiple-listeners)
- [TCP listener parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/tcp-reference)
- [Unix listener parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/listeners/unix-reference)

## Metrics

Controllers and workers export metrics that Prometheus can collect. Metrics provide insight into the current state of a deployment and help you detect and diagnose anomalies.

- [Configure metrics collection](/boundary/docs/monitor/configure-metrics)
- [Boundary metrics reference](/boundary/docs/monitor/metrics)

## Health

Controllers and workers report their status through the `/health` endpoint on the `ops` listener.

- [Boundary health endpoints](/boundary/docs/monitor/health)
- [Check the health endpoint](/boundary/docs/monitor/check-health-endpoint)
- [Health endpoint reference](/boundary/docs/monitor/health-reference)

## Events

Boundary can emit audit, observation, system, and telemetry events. You route events to file or stderr sinks, and you can send events to more than one sink.

- [Configure event sinks](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/configure-sinks)
- [Filter events](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/filter-events)
- [Events stanza parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/events)
- [Common sink parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/common)
- [File sink parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/file)
- [Stderr sink parameters](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/stderr)
